handoff.residue: Both component-reuse schedules first attain retention exactly at boundary 3 and spend their final action restoring H at boundary 10. The conventional clip has substantially fewer actions. Those differences must remain visible alongside any originality discussion.
handoff.summary: Replay the three exact action lists independently using next-boundary completion, one operator, four-unit retention at ticks 3 through 6, and removal by boundary 10. C uses direct clip retention; SV requires detached S and both sleeve steps; ML requires detached M and both placement/routing steps. Preserve identities and mutually exclusive non-pin assemblies. No pins, outside resources, theta assumption, or manual support. Reopen on a changed constraint or concrete replay failure; refuse unsupported physics and external novelty claims.
